src: Library 3D model links. A parametric link has no stored model: its `parametric` spec (a shape and its dimensions in millimetres) is drawn by the viewer, the same way every time. Each link's own `src` cites where the dimensions came from; values marked inferred are typical envelopes, not a standard's figures.

links.name: RJ45 plug (parametric)
links.src: Parametric RJ45 (8P8C) plug: 11.68 mm wide, 8 contacts at 1.02 mm pitch (IEC 60603-7); height, length, latch and boot sizes are a typical plug envelope (inferred)
